parallels.note: Then I said to you, “Don’t be terrified. Don’t be afraid of them.

translations.web: “Don’t say, ‘A conspiracy!’ concerning all about which this people say, ‘A conspiracy!’ neither fear their threats, nor be terrorized.
translations.bsb: “Do not call conspiracy everything these people regard as conspiracy. Do not fear what they fear; do not live in dread.
translations.kjv: Say ye not, A confederacy, to all them to whom this people shall say, A confederacy; neither fear ye their fear, nor be afraid.
translations.asv: Say ye not, A conspiracy, concerning all whereof this people shall say, A conspiracy; neither fear ye their fear, nor be in dread thereof.
